item.title: European consumers ask EU to put a stop to digital enshittification
item.description: Online rights campaigners have come together to complain about the propensity of IT companies to make life more difficult for their users. The groups, mainly from Europe but with some from the US, have written to policy makers in the EU/EEA, UK and the US. The initiative has been spearheaded by Forbrukerrådet (the Norwegian Consumer Council) which complained of the “enshittification” of software. item.title: Gov’t IT spending seen as key to building Europe’s tech ecosystem
item.description: As more European organizations reconsider their reliance on US technology suppliers amid rising geopolitical and trade tensions, public sector organizations are leading the way in a potential shift to local tech providers. item.title: ClickFix attackers using new tactic to evade detection, says Microsoft
item.description: Threat actors are trying a different tactic to sucker employees into falling for ClickFix phishing attacks that install malware, says Microsoft. item.description: OpenAI is an artificial intelligence organization comprised of the non-profit OpenAI, Inc. and several for-profit subsidiaries. item.title: M365 Copilot gets its own version of Claude Cowork
item.description: Microsoft has added agentic AI capabilities to Microsoft 365 Copilot to improve its usefulness for office workers — including its own version of Anthropic’s Claude Cowork. Microsoft’s AI assistant has, so far, failed to attract significant business demand since launching more than two years ago, at least compared to its other products. Only 3% of the Microsoft 365 customer base is subscribed to the paid version of the AI agent, Microsoft said last month, with a total of 15 million paid licenses.

item.title: Why markets are worrying about Apple today
item.description: The human and environmental costs of the ongoing conflict in the Middle East are bad enough on their own, but there are other impacts likely to be felt. item.title: Job disruption by AI remains limited — and traditional metrics may be missing the real impact
item.description: AI’s impact on human jobs is a hot topic of late, with all kinds of forecasting, reporting, and sounding of alarm bells.
